Builddrone 0.5.1 is a security release. It closes remaining symlink bypasses in
`filesystem.copy` and `appveyor.upload.artifact` that could leak host or
CI-readable files into later publish steps.

**Documentation:** https://nepitwin.github.io/Builddrone/latest/

---

## Security fixes

### Filesystem copy source-directory symlink rejection

`filesystem.copy` now rejects a `source` whose resolved path is a directory
symlink before `os.walk`. Nested folder walks still use `followlinks=False`,
and symlinked files continue to be skipped with a warning.

This prevents a contributor from replacing a configured copy source with a
directory symlink so that CI-readable host or secrets files are materialized
as regular files under the destination and published by a later archiver or
upload step.

### AppVeyor artifact upload symlink rejection

`appveyor.upload.artifact` now rejects listed artifact paths that are
symlinks in `_resolve_file` before `Push-AppveyorArtifact` runs. Uploads fail
with a clear error instead of following the link and sending the target bytes
to AppVeyor.

This matches the existing symlink rejection in `appveyor.upload.tests` and
`twine.upload`.
